purpose: Per CEO R302 P5+P6: 'Every one of the 15 candidates must eventually have 10 executable components. Build a machine-readable board. No candidate can be called BUYER_READY until the buyer can actually execute or independently evaluate something.'
constitutional_basis: Article XXXV (closed-loop epistemic control). Article XXVIII (no silent semantic promotion — 'working' means buyer can run it, not that we can describe it).

the_10_executable_components.name: Mechanism
the_10_executable_components.description: What physically causes the claimed effect? Must be specific enough to falsify.

the_10_executable_components.name: Reference Implementation
the_10_executable_components.description: A working simulator, algorithm, CAD/engineering model, experimental prototype, or computational implementation that can be RUN, not just described.

the_10_executable_components.name: Strongest Comparator
the_10_executable_components.description: Not a straw man. The strongest publicly documented approach that could serve the same function.

the_10_executable_components.name: Attack Suite
the_10_executable_components.description: At least several realistic failure modes that the candidate must survive.

the_10_executable_components.name: Falsification Criterion
the_10_executable_components.description: Frozen before testing. What specific result would kill the candidate?

the_10_executable_components.name: Evidence Ledger
the_10_executable_components.description: Every number gets provenance. LITERATURE_VERIFIED / EXPERIMENTALLY_MEASURED / MODELLED / BUYER_UNVERIFIED.

the_10_executable_components.name: Reproduction Package
the_10_executable_components.description: A technically competent buyer can run it independently. Code, data, instructions, calibration.

the_10_executable_components.name: Buyer Evaluation Protocol
the_10_executable_components.description: Buyer doesn't have to trust us. Blinded, pre-registered, falsification-capable.

the_10_executable_components.name: Feedback Ingestion
the_10_executable_components.description: Buyer criticism becomes machine-readable evidence. Structured schema for objections.

the_10_executable_components.name: Version Loop
the_10_executable_components.description: BUYER → QUESTION/OBJECTION/FAILURE → KNOWLEDGE ATOM → NEW REQUIREMENT → NEW ATTACK → SIMULATION/EXPERIMENT → V2/V3 → NEW BUYER PACKAGE

board_summary.honest_assessment: Only 3 of 15 active candidates (P-01, P-03, P-07) have anything a buyer can actually run. P-04 has a protocol a collaborator can execute. The other 11 are descriptions, not working packages. The objective is to get all 15 to the minimum state where a buyer can evaluate something.
board_summary.the_rule: No candidate can be called BUYER_READY until the buyer can actually execute or independently evaluate something.

the_real_moat.not_any_single_candidate: The moat is not P-01 or P-16 or any individual technology.
the_real_moat.the_moat: An AI system that repeatedly converts uncertain technical hypotheses into buyer-evaluable technology packages, while learning from every failure and every buyer response.
the_real_moat.the_pipeline: AI discovers → AI researches → AI attacks prior art → AI models → AI builds reference implementation → AI falsifies → AI repairs → AI validates → AI packages → buyer runs → buyer attacks → AI ingests feedback → AI redesigns → buyer re-tests → transaction.
the_real_moat.applied_to_all_15: P-01 is the reference implementation of this pipeline. Once P-01's loop works end-to-end, the same machinery applies to P-02, P-03, ... P-16. That is the real moat.
